deploy-bot: [deploy] production deploy STARTED · service=inference-runtime · env=prod-us-west-2 · tag=v3.4.7-rc4 · commit=d1c4f9e · change_window=11:00-12:00 UTC · rollout=canary 10% -> full over 20m · notes=enable_prefix_cache=true

sam: ack, I'm watching canary metrics (latency / error / cpu). ping me on spikes.

elena: starting smoke tests: `/health` and a short generate with prompt 'smoke test'

deploy-bot: canary deployed to shard `usw2-canary-3` · nodes pinned to pool `gpu-v5-8x` · logs: https://logs.redwood/prod/inference-runtime/d1c4f9e

raj: quick check — seeing kv-cache growth config? suggest set `caching.max_entries=20000` for canary to limit mem churn.

maria: I'm going to pin rollout variant on the canary pool to avoid mixed weights while we validate. will also add note in release notes.

oncall-sre: seeing a small 5xx spike on canary at +6m, investigating traces now.

sam: isolating — traces show unexpected tokenizer errors for longer prompts, looks like the tokenizer change in rc4.

elena: can we patch config to fallback tokenizer for now? prefer patch to full binary rollback.

deploy-bot: ALERT: canary paused at 10% by policy due to error rate > threshold (auto-pause). Options: rollback tag to v3.4.6 OR apply config patch and redeploy canary.

raj: let's try config patch first (tokenizer fallback). if errors persist after 5m -> rollback binary.

maria: applied `tokenizer.fallback=true` and repinned canary variant as `v3.4.7-rc4-patch1`. triggering canary redeploy now.

deploy-bot: canary REDEPLOY STARTED -> tag=v3.4.7-rc4-patch1 · commit=d1c4f9e-p1 · redeploy target=usw2-canary-3

sam: re-running smoke: `/health` OK, generate sample OK. latency looks stable in the last 2 minutes.

oncall-sre: no further 5xx observed, error budget unaffected. recommend continue rollout. :+1:

maria: advancing rollout to 50% over 10m (controlled ramp). will watch p95 and error-rate.

deploy-bot: rollout progressing: 10% -> 25% -> 50% · telemetry snapshot: cpu +2% · p95 +18ms · errors nominal

elena: kicking off regression evals against the baseline prompt suite; will post summary in 10m.

sam: metrics green on dashboard, logs look clean. ok to proceed to full if regressions are fine.

raj: note — change-window ends at 12:00 UTC, final promote must complete before then. if we hit any more instability, we'll call a rollback and schedule a follow-up cutover.

maria: starting final promote to 100% now. pinning final tag across all prod pools.

deploy-bot: PROMOTION STARTED -> target=100% · applying tag `v3.4.7-rc4-patch1` to all prod nodes · pin enforced

deploy-bot: PRODUCTION DEPLOY COMPLETE · service=inference-runtime · env=prod-us-west-2 · final_tag=v3.4.7 · commit=d1c4f9e-p1 · duration=22m · rollout=100% · notes="tokenizer fallback applied; pin enforced" · rollback_policy=auto-fallback-to-v3.4.6-if-errors · release_notes=https://releases.redwood/v3.4.7 · dashboard=https://dash.redwood/inference-runtime/overview · logs=https://logs.redwood/prod/inference-runtime/d1c4f9e-p1

sam: nice work team. will keep monitoring thru the hour.

elena: posting regression eval summary in product channel in 5m.

maria: tagging release artifacts and creating follow-up issue to revert fallback once tokenizer patch lands in main.

oncall-sre: closing incident note: no action required, deploy completed cleanly. :tada:
